en: The postcard features an old, monochrome photograph with a yellow-tinted background. It depicts an ornate bridge in the foreground and a large church with a distinctive Baroque onion-domed tower in the center. There are sculptures on pillars near the bridge and several buildings in the background, indicating an urban setting. The text at the top reads 'Graz' on the left and 'Franziskaner Kirche' on the right.
